label: Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 Hits
delta: 'SWIM' closed out its Hot 100 run at 20 consecutive weeks — tying (not surpassing) 'Butter' (2021) for BTS's longest-ever run — after exiting the chart dated Aug 22, 2026, following its No. 91 peak week on Aug 15.

label: Billboard 200 No. 1 Albums
delta: ARIRANG held 3 consecutive #1 weeks (K-pop first); now marks its 23rd consecutive charting week (No. 31, chart dated Sept 5) — longest sustained K-pop album run in Billboard 200 history.

label: Grammy Award Nominations
contestNote: No Grammy wins despite 5 nominations across 3 ceremonies

label: Billboard Music Awards Won
delta: Most of any act in BBMA history (as of 2022). Note: separate from AMA wins (14 total, record).

label: Days Since Debut
delta: Day 4,838 (Sept 11). Since the last update: RM's early birthday celebration at the SoFi Stadium finale (Sept 6) and a viral backstage photo of Son Heung-min with V and Jungkook (Sept 8) circulated as the tour's North American leg wrapped.

label: American Music Awards Wins (Total)
delta: +3 at 52nd AMAs (May 25, 2026): Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer ('SWIM'), Best Male K-Pop Artist. Most decorated act in AMA history.

label: IFPI Global Recording Artist of the Year
ARIRANG World Tour European Leg Attendance
delta: 10 shows, 5 cities (Madrid, Brussels, London, Munich, Paris). First Korean act to headline Brussels' King Baudouin Stadium and Munich's Allianz Arena; highest-attended show ever at London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium; Paris finale drew a BTS-record 92,000 fans in one show.

label: HYBE Q2 2026 Revenue
delta: +105.5% YoY, +107.6% QoQ — record quarter. Concert revenue up 243.3% YoY to ₩647.7B, attributed directly to the ARIRANG World Tour.

label: ARIRANG World Tour Gross Revenue
delta: 2.3M tickets across 38 shows (through Aug 11) — highest-grossing tour ever by a vocal group, surpassing BTS's own 'Love Yourself' tour and BLACKPINK's 'Born Pink' ($331.8M) as the top Asian-artist tour.

label: ARIRANG Tour North American Leg Attendance
delta: 31 sold-out shows across 12 cities (Apr 25–Sept 6). SoFi Stadium's 4-show LA stand alone drew ~282K; combined with BTS's 2021 shows there, the group's 8 total SoFi concerts drew a cumulative 496K — the venue's all-time record for any act.
